text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: inference-queue-frontend backlog > 92% (5m avg). autoscaler 'scale-controller' has 15% failed scale attempts. page fired at 8019991110
sara (oncall): acked — I'm on it. starting initial triage.
pagerduty: Pager acknowledged by sara (oncall). escalation window: 5m -> 15m.
mike (infra): looking at node allocation logs — cloud API returning 429 on create calls. suspect provider quota throttle.
olivia (eng): can we trigger manual scale to bypass autoscaler while we investigate? also considering temporary routing to model-1-small.
sara (oncall): doing manual scale to add 4 nodes to inference-cell-3 now.
sara (oncall): ```# manual scale command
./infractl scale --cell inference-cell-3 --add-nodes 4 --type gpus
```
incident-bot: Manual scale job started: job_id=ms-8019991110-1.
sara (oncall): job shows "provisioning". ETA ~2m.
mike (infra): opened provider support ticket (SUP-4553). adding note: observed 429s for project quotas. will try alternate zone spin-up as fallback.
olivia (eng): enable fallback routing to model-1-small for non-critical routes? that reduces per-request GPU need and should lower queue pressure.
nate (sre): +1 to fallback routing. also please pause non-essential batch jobs hitting the queue (jobs tagged "batch/low-priority").
sara (oncall): pausing low-priority batch now. ```POST /admin/pause-jobs { "tag": "batch/low-priority" }```
sara (oncall): provisioning complete, nodes added, kube nodes ready. beginning backlog drain.
jess (cs): seeing customer reports of slow responses and 504s from a handful of high-volume tenants. informing support teams and giving ETA ~10m.
olivia (eng): rolling out model fallback rule (rate-limit + reroute). config snippet: ```rules: - match: /generate priority: low action: route:model-1-small```
sara (oncall): traffic shaping + added capacity brought latency down from 3.2s median to 1.1s in the last 90s. backlog reduced from 18k -> 4.2k.
mike (infra): alternate-zone spin initiated as backup; provider is still responding with 429s on primary zone. SUP-4553 updated.
nate (sre): monitoring for autoscaler health — looks like scale-controller crashed-restarted twice during the spike, crash logs attached to the incident.
ols (typo): (no action)
sara (oncall): marking this thread as mitigation-in-progress. next: postmortem & quota hardening.
jess (cs): support notified customers impacted, offering transparent update. no SLA breaches yet but close for a few tenants.
olivia (eng): will patch scale-controller to retry on 429 with exponential backoff and queue a local manual-fallback if cloud API errors persist.
sara (oncall): summary for handoff: manual scale + fallback routing active, low-priority jobs paused, provider ticket open, monitoring shows steady recovery. handing to nate for night coverage.
nate (sre): taking handoff. will watch queue until under 500 and confirm autoscaler back to healthy. please add any follow-up items to the incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident mitigation logged. resolution pending verification.
sara (oncall): thanks team — adding TODOs: (1) provider quota review, (2) scale-controller retry logic, (3) runbook update for manual scale + fallback.
incident-bot: Thread last updated at 8019991350.
